interface_decision.semantic_role: the normal-subgroup quotient carrier, group operations, and canonical quotient homomorphism consumed by the Sylow normalizer quotient
interface_decision.litex_form: reuse cosets::quotient_group_carrier directly; construct typed multiplication and inverse by unique representative-independent values; package an explicit Group

proof_spine: A normal subgroup's left-coset carrier is nonempty and every coset has a representative.
Normality makes multiplication and inverse independent of representatives.
Representative formulas prove associativity, identity, and inverse laws on the quotient.
Package the operations as a Group and expose the canonical projection as a group homomorphism.

thm left_coset_mul_mem:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, H power_set(G), a, b, x, y G:
        $normal_subgroup::is_normal_subgroup(G, group, H)
        x $in \cosets::left_coset<G, group>(H, a)
        y $in \cosets::left_coset<G, group>(H, b)
        =>:
            group.mul(x, y) $in \cosets::left_coset<G, group>(H, group.mul(a, b))
    by def:
        ? $group::group_laws(G, group.mul, group.one, group.inv)
    \cosets::left_coset<G, group>(H, group.mul(a, b)) = {q G: $cosets::left_coset_member(G, group, H, group.mul(a, b), q)}
    obtain u from exist h G st {h $in H, x = group.mul(a, h)}
    obtain v from exist h G st {h $in H, y = group.mul(b, h)}
    release thm group_inv_inv(G, group, b)
    group.mul(group.mul(group.inv(b), u), group.inv(group.inv(b))) $in H
    group.inv(group.inv(b)) = b
    group.mul(group.mul(group.inv(b), u), group.inv(group.inv(b))) = group.mul(group.mul(group.inv(b), u), b)
    have moved G = group.mul(group.mul(group.inv(b), u), b)
    moved $in H
    group.mul(moved, v) $in H
    release thm group::mul_inv_cancel(G, group.mul, group.one, group.inv, b)
    group.mul(b, group.mul(group.inv(b), u)) = group.mul(group.mul(b, group.inv(b)), u)
    release thm cosets::object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(t, b)}, group.mul(b, group.mul(group.inv(b), u)), group.mul(group.mul(b, group.inv(b)), u))
    group.mul(b, moved) = group.mul(b, group.mul(group.mul(group.inv(b), u), b)) = group.mul(group.mul(b, group.mul(group.inv(b), u)), b) = group.mul(group.mul(group.mul(b, group.inv(b)), u), b)
    group.mul(b, group.inv(b)) = group.one
    release thm cosets::object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(group.mul(t, u), b)}, group.mul(b, group.inv(b)), group.one)
    group.mul(group.mul(group.mul(b, group.inv(b)), u), b) = group.mul(group.mul(group.one, u), b)
    group.mul(group.one, u) = u
    release thm cosets::object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(t, b)}, group.mul(group.one, u), u)
    group.mul(group.mul(group.one, u), b) = group.mul(u, b)
    group.mul(b, moved) = group.mul(u, b)
    group.mul(u, group.mul(b, v)) = group.mul(group.mul(u, b), v)
    release thm cosets::object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(t, v)}, group.mul(u, b), group.mul(b, moved))
    group.mul(group.mul(u, b), v) = group.mul(group.mul(b, moved), v)
    group.mul(group.mul(b, moved), v) = group.mul(b, group.mul(moved, v))
    group.mul(u, group.mul(b, v)) = group.mul(b, group.mul(moved, v))
    release thm cosets::object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(a, t)}, group.mul(u, group.mul(b, v)), group.mul(b, group.mul(moved, v)))
    group.mul(a, group.mul(u, group.mul(b, v))) = group.mul(a, group.mul(b, group.mul(moved, v)))
    group.mul(x, y) = group.mul(group.mul(a, u), group.mul(b, v)) = group.mul(a, group.mul(u, group.mul(b, v))) = group.mul(a, group.mul(b, group.mul(moved, v))) = group.mul(group.mul(a, b), group.mul(moved, v))
    witness $cosets::left_coset_member(G, group, H, group.mul(a, b), group.mul(x, y)) from group.mul(moved, v)
    release thm set_builder_member(group.mul(x, y), {q G: $cosets::left_coset_member(G, group, H, group.mul(a, b), q)})
    group.mul(x, y) $in {q G: $cosets::left_coset_member(G, group, H, group.mul(a, b), q)}
